_crosswalk.description: Old curriculum bank (curriculum_by_course.json before the 2026 rebuild) → rebuilt bank ids, for Re-link. pairs[old course] lists each old competency (its code and wording) with the new competencies that replace it: one for a rewording, several where the old line joined several Ministry statements. Old competencies with no Ministry counterpart, or no clear one, are left out and stay the teacher’s own. courses lists old course keys that were dropped or renamed. Built from ~/reports/stage4-crosswalk/ with a hand pass (stage 4 plan, Nov 2 2026).
